title: Richard Doty describes his role as an AFOSI counterintelligence officer
place_text: Air Force Office of Special Investigations

tellings.quote: I was a Counter Intelligence officer for the Air Force offic Special investigation

plain: A former US Air Force man named Richard Doty, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that in the 1970s and 1980s he was a counterintelligence officer, someone whose job is to catch and mislead enemy spies, for the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigative agency. It matters because if he held that job, he would have been placed to know, or to shape, what the Air Force said about UFOs in those years.
